To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) The magnetic flux self organizes around the critical current during relaxation, (ii) The relaxation in this self organization process is a power law, (iii) The power law exponent is a function of temperature and field, (iv) The power law relaxation is a new time scale, (v) The new time scale along with the thermally activated time scale dynamically identify the irreversibility line.

the irreversibility line in the H-T phase diagram is a consequence of the magnetic relaxation of the superconductor and the irreversibility is due to the emergence of a new time window of the magnetic relaxation.
the magnetic relaxation in the intermediate time window, which is a power law, is a signature of the irreversibility of a hard superconductor.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the understanding of the irreversibility line in hard superconductors and the dynamics of the vortex lattice.
the magnetic relaxation in superconductors.
understanding the dynamics of the flux line lattice (FLL) in hard superconductors.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the magnetic relaxation is the key to the irreversibility phenomenon.
magnetic relaxation in the intermediate time window is the most reliable method to determine irreversibility temperature of hard superconductors.
the irreversibility line is a line of transition from the long time relaxation due the thermally activated process to the short time relaxation due to the self organization of the flux.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have shown that the time scale for magnetic relaxation in hard superconductor is a double power law with a break at the irreversibility line.
the irreversibility line is not an equilibrium line and the irreversibility field is not a thermodynamic quantity.
the irreversibility is a time scale dependent phenomenon.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the irreversibility line is the line of the transition from a disordered state to an ordered state.
the irreversibility line can be determined from magnetic relaxation data.
the irreversibility line can be identified from the relaxation time scale.
